name: Moto, Michibikareshi Onna Yuusha-tachi
source:
Based on the  RPG Dragon Quest IV.

In the darkness of a deep cave that humans cannot reach, dwells a devil king ... and you, his lowly goblin servant.
One day while running an errand, you catch news of mysterious hero. And wouldn't it just happen that she's a heroine!
You've got to act fast before Psaro, the evil priests and all the other bad guys find out. Using this news, you assemble a gobliny crew, and set in motion a plan to supplant the devil king ...

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE059934.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
本作改编自RPG《勇者斗恶龙IV：被引导的人们》。

在人类无法抵达的深邃洞穴里，栖息着一位魔王……而你，只是他手下卑微的哥布林仆从。
某天外出办事时，你听说了一名神秘勇者的消息。更巧的是，她竟然还是位女勇者！
你必须赶在皮萨罗、邪恶神官和其他坏蛋得知消息前迅速行动。借助这条情报，你召集了一群哥布林伙伴，开始谋划取代魔王……

[改编自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE059934.html]DLsite英文站[/url]]
